name: Zabbix MCP Server
description: Exposes the complete Zabbix API to MCP-compatible AI assistants, enabling natural language management of hosts, problems, and templates across multiple instances. It provides 220 tools for comprehensive monitoring and configuration with support for read-only modes and secure authentication.
